source.title: PitchBook deal record: Series B

corroboration.publisher: TechCrunch (total funding to date $704M at Series B)

events.notes: DISPUTED: PB $980M vs T1 $580M (gap $400M, +69%). Pre/post and announced/closed do not explain it: pre+size=post holds inside PB, and shares x price = 87.30M x $11.2261 = $980M, so PB models a single 87.3M-share Series B at one price. Most plausible (unverified) reading: PB aggregates later Series B-priced closings on top of the April 2022 $580M; a $400M delta is the same order as Google's Feb-2023 investment (FT: $300M for ~10%; $300M/$3.0B post = 10%), but PB does not list Google in the Series B investor list and first dates Alphabet at the 2023-06-30 Series C (investors file), so the link is NOT established. Resolution needs PB deal participants/cap table or the S-1 capitalization table. FTX-estate filing: 29,465,891 of its ~44.5M shares were sold in Mar 2024 at $30.0045 (see FTX event); Protos (opened) quotes the estate filing: 44,539,240 Series B preferred at $11.2261 = $500M, which matches the DOJ-stated ~$500M and PB's Series B price; Protos dates the purchase Oct 5 2021 vs DOJ '2022' (timeline conflict, see conflicts). PB also carries the same $11.2261 on Series C although its valuations rise 37% (post-B $3.0B to pre-C $4.1B): either +98M FD shares between rounds or a PB price/share-count error.
